description: SAMI3 simulates ionospheric plasma chemistry and dynamics for multiple ion species. Its three-dimensional formulation includes motion along geomagnetic fields and supporting empirical neutral-atmosphere inputs. The resource is documented by NRL. The documented physical domain is Global Ionosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request, Public Repository. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. External neutral conditions and model configuration affect the resulting plasma state. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
